items.title: The urinary-metabolite-based lung cancer index (uLCI): an interpretable machine-learning risk model for early-stage disease
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundFive-year survival from lung cancer exceeds 60% at stage I-II but falls below 10% once metastasis occurs. Low-dose CT (LDCT) screening reduces mortality in heavy smokers but carries a false-positive rate of approximately 29% and is restricted to smoking-based eligibility, leaving most cases undetected. We aimed to develop and independently validate an interpretable machine-learning urinary metabolite risk index (uLCI) for non-invasive lung cancer detection. MethodsFour urinary metabolites--creatine riboside (CR), N-acetylneuraminic acid (NANA), 27-nor-5{beta}-cholestane-3,7,12,24R,25S-pentol (CP), and cortisol sulfate (CS)--and three clinical variables (age, race, smoking) were integrated by Lasso-regularised logistic regression into a uLCI score. The model was developed under 10-fold cross-validation in the NCI-Maryland (NCI-MD) cohort (n=845; 470 controls, 375 cases, stages I-IV) and applied without refitting to the independent Colorado Lung Cancer Cohort (n=488; 211 controls, 277 cases). Analyses were prespecified; reporting followed TRIPOD+AI. FindingsuLCI achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0{middle dot}906 (95% CI 0{middle dot}887-0{middle dot}926) in NCI-MD and 0{middle dot}748 (0{middle dot}701-0{middle dot}793) in the independent Colorado cohort. Scores rose monotonically across stages in both cohorts (Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}69 and 0{middle dot}45; both p<0{middle dot}0001). Stage-specific discrimination was preserved from stage I to IV (NCI-MD 0{middle dot}900-0{middle dot}927; Colorado 0{middle dot}722-0{middle dot}843). Net reclassification improvement over clinical variables was 1{middle dot}24 (1{middle dot}14-1{middle dot}36) and 0{middle dot}74 (0{middle dot}56-0{middle dot}90). uLCI tertiles stratified post-resection survival in stage I-II disease (adjusted hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03, 1{middle dot}26-3{middle dot}27). InterpretationuLCI is an independently validated, interpretable urinary risk index that detects lung cancer across all stages, with monotonic stage progression and post-resection prognostic value. Its false-positive rate compares favourably with published estimates for LDCT and cell-free-DNA assays, supporting prospective head-to-head evaluation as a non-invasive triage tool, including in screening-ineligible populations. Research in contextO_ST_ABSEvidence before this studyC_ST_ABSWe searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science from Jan 1, 2000, to Jan 31, 2026, without language restriction, for biomarker-based diagnostic or risk models for lung cancer, using "lung cancer", "early detection", "biomarker", "urine", "metabolite", "machine learning", "TRIPOD", and "validation in an independent cohort". Five-year survival exceeds 60% at stage I-II but falls below 10% after metastasis. Low-dose CT reduces mortality in heavy smokers but carries an approximately 29% false-positive rate and excludes never-smokers, who account for 10-25% of US lung cancers and up to 40% globally; blood-based cell-free DNA and methylation assays report rates near 27%. Most prior urinary-metabolite work, including our 2024 creatine-riboside and N-acetylneuraminic-acid report, used case-control designs without a locked, integrated model, and--even where two cohorts were analyzed--lacked prespecified independent validation or TRIPOD+AI-compliant reporting; an interpretable urinary index integrating an expanded metabolite panel with clinical variables under these standards had not been described. Added value of this studyAcross two cohorts (1333 individuals), we developed and independently validated uLCI, an interpretable Lasso-regularised logistic index combining four urinary metabolites (CR, NANA, CP, CS) with age, race, and smoking, reported to TRIPOD+AI standards. The prespecified locked model achieved an AUC of 0{middle dot}906 (95% CI 0{middle dot}887-0{middle dot}926) in NCI-MD development and 0{middle dot}748 (0{middle dot}701-0{middle dot}793) in the independent Colorado cohort without refitting, with discrimination preserved from stage I to IV (0{middle dot}900-0{middle dot}927; 0{middle dot}722-0{middle dot}843). uLCI rose monotonically with stage in both cohorts (Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}693 and 0{middle dot}449; both p<0{middle dot}0001), improved reclassification over clinical variables (net reclassification improvement 1{middle dot}24 and 0{middle dot}74), and independently stratified post-resection survival in stage I-II disease (adjusted hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03 in NCI-MD; 3{middle dot}81 in Colorado). On indirect benchmarking, the 17-19% false-positive rate was below published estimates for low-dose CT ([~]29%) and DELFI ([~]27%), and discrimination was preserved in never-smokers -- whom low-dose CT excludes -- and across racial subgroups in the diverse development cohort. Implications of all the available evidenceA locked, independently validated, non-invasive urinary index that is interpretable, accurate from stage I, stage-responsive, and prognostic after resection addresses a defined detection gap, with a plausible role as a low-cost triage test that raises pre-test probability before imaging and extends risk assessment to screening-ineligible never-smokers, complementary to low-dose CT. Prospective screening-cohort evaluation (planned in the NCI PLCO and Southern Community Cohort biobanks), head-to-head comparison with blood-based assays, recalibration to screening prevalence, and replication in diverse cohorts are the warranted next steps.
items.summary_zh: uLCI 将4种尿液代谢物与年龄、种族和吸烟情况整合为可解释的肺癌检测风险指数，并在独立队列中完成无重新拟合验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究覆盖1,333人且遵循预设分析与 TRIPOD+AI 报告；独立队列表现下降也提示其仍需在前瞻性筛查人群中校准和比较。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：肺癌患者在 I–II 期的五年生存率超过60%，但一旦发生转移则降至10%以下。低剂量 CT（LDCT）筛查可降低重度吸烟者的死亡率，但假阳性率约为29%，且其资格限于吸烟标准，因而大量病例未被检出。我们旨在开发并独立验证一种可解释的机器学习尿液代谢物风险指数（uLCI），用于无创肺癌检测。方法：以 Lasso 正则化逻辑回归将4种尿液代谢物——creatine riboside（CR）、N-acetylneuraminic acid（NANA）、27-nor-5{beta}-cholestane-3,7,12,24R,25S-pentol（CP）和 cortisol sulfate（CS）——与3项临床变量（年龄、种族、吸烟）整合为 uLCI 评分。该模型在 NCI-Maryland（NCI-MD）队列中以10折交叉验证开发（n=845；470名对照、375名病例；I–IV期），随后不经重新拟合应用于独立 Colorado Lung Cancer Cohort（n=488；211名对照、277名病例）。分析预先规定；报告遵循 TRIPOD+AI。结果：uLCI 在 NCI-MD 中的曲线下面积（AUC）为0{middle dot}906（95% CI 0{middle dot}887–0{middle dot}926），在独立 Colorado 队列中为0{middle dot}748（0{middle dot}701–0{middle dot}793）。两个队列的评分均随分期单调升高（Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}69 和0{middle dot}45；均 p<0{middle dot}0001）。从 I 期至 IV 期均保持了分期特异性区分能力（NCI-MD 为0{middle dot}900–0{middle dot}927；Colorado 为0{middle dot}722–0{middle dot}843）。相对于临床变量的净重分类改善分别为1{middle dot}24（1{middle dot}14–1{middle dot}36）和0{middle dot}74（0{middle dot}56–0{middle dot}90）。uLCI 三分位数可对 I–II 期疾病术后生存进行分层（校正后风险比2{middle dot}03，1{middle dot}26–3{middle dot}27）。解释：uLCI 是经独立验证、可解释的尿液风险指数，可检测各期肺癌，呈现单调的分期进展关系，并具有术后预后价值。其假阳性率与已发表的 LDCT 和无细胞 DNA 检测结果相比更有利，支持将其作为无创分诊工具开展前瞻性头对头评估，包括用于不符合筛查资格的人群。研究背景：本研究前的证据：我们检索了 PubMed、Embase 和 Web of Science，自2000年1月1日至2026年1月31日，不限语言，检索肺癌的生物标志物诊断或风险模型，关键词包括“lung cancer”“early detection”“biomarker”“urine”“metabolite”“machine learning”“TRIPOD”和“validation in an independent cohort”。I–II期肺癌的五年生存率超过60%，发生转移后低于10%。低剂量 CT 可降低重度吸烟者死亡率，但假阳性率约29%，并排除从不吸烟者；从不吸烟者占美国肺癌的10–25%，全球可达40%。血液 cfDNA 和甲基化检测报告的假阳性率接近27%。此前大多数尿液代谢物研究，包括我们2024年关于 creatine riboside 和 N-acetylneuraminic acid 的报告，采用未锁定的病例对照设计；即使分析了两个队列，也缺乏预设的独立验证或符合 TRIPOD+AI 的报告。此前尚未描述在这些标准下整合扩展代谢物面板与临床变量的、可解释的尿液指数。本研究的附加价值：我们在两个队列（1,333人）中开发并独立验证了 uLCI；这是一个可解释的 Lasso 正则化逻辑指数，整合4种尿液代谢物（CR、NANA、CP、CS）以及年龄、种族和吸烟，并按 TRIPOD+AI 标准报告。预设锁定模型在 NCI-MD 开发队列的 AUC 为0{middle dot}906（95% CI 0{middle dot}887–0{middle dot}926），在未重新拟合的独立 Colorado 队列为0{middle dot}748（0{middle dot}701–0{middle dot}793）；从 I 期至 IV 期保持区分能力（0{middle dot}900–0{middle dot}927；0{middle dot}722–0{middle dot}843）。两个队列中 uLCI 随分期单调升高（Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}693 和0{middle dot}449；均 p<0{middle dot}0001），相对临床变量改善重分类（净重分类改善1{middle dot}24 和0{middle dot}74），并独立区分 I–II 期术后生存（NCI-MD 校正后风险比2{middle dot}03；Colorado 为3{middle dot}81）。在间接基准比较中，17–19%的假阳性率低于已发表低剂量 CT（约29%）和 DELFI（约27%）的估计值；在低剂量 CT 排除的从不吸烟者以及多样化开发队列的不同种族亚组中，区分能力仍得到保持。现有全部证据的意义：一个锁定、经独立验证、无创、可解释、从 I 期起准确、与分期相关且可预测术后预后的尿液指数，针对的是明确的检测缺口；它可能作为低成本分诊检测，在影像检查前提高检验前概率，并将风险评估扩展至不符合筛查资格的从不吸烟者，与低剂量 CT 互补。合理的下一步包括在 NCI PLCO 和 Southern Community Cohort 生物样本库计划开展前瞻性筛查队列评估、与血液检测进行头对头比较、按筛查患病率重新校准，以及在多样化队列中重复验证。
items.author_line: Khan, M. A., Pine, S. R., Gonzalez, F. J., Wang, X. W., Harris, C. C., Patel, D. P.

items.title: Explainable Transformer Models for Clinical Prediction Tasks on Structured Electronic Health Records
items.abstract_or_text: Predictive models over structured electronic health records (EHRs) remain central to machine learning for healthcare, but few have jointly emphasized quantitative laboratory information and interpretability with respect to input medical events. We present BERT-LER, a BERT-style model for coded EHR timelines pretrained and fine-tuned from a de-identified EHR dataset of 75 million patients, that encodes laboratory test results as discrete tokens while retaining graded information through percentile-based binning, paired with Integrated Gradients for token-level attributions grounded in the input EHR sequence. We benchmark our approach on the public EHRShot benchmark suite and on an asthma severity progression study based on real-world data. This addresses a methodological gap in EHR foundation-style modeling by unifying laboratory value representation and explainability in a single framework, while assessing whether both predictive performance and explanations generalize beyond standard clinical prediction tasks. Across EHRShot and asthma tasks, BERT-LER achieves predictive performance that is competitive with, and on laboratory-related tasks often exceeds, publicly available benchmark models, and provides attributions that align with clinically known risk factors. Our architecture and explainability approach can be applied to many therapeutic areas and prediction tasks using language models trained on structured EHRs.
items.summary_zh: BERT-LER 在7,500万名患者的去标识化 EHR 上预训练，以百分位分箱表示检验值，并给出事件级归因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模真实世界 EHR、公开 EHRShot 基准和哮喘任务使其成为结构化临床预测的重要方法候选；归因与已知风险因素一致仍不能证明模型具备临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）上的预测模型仍是医疗机器学习的核心，但很少有研究同时强调定量实验室信息和相对于输入医疗事件的可解释性。我们提出 BERT-LER：一种用于编码 EHR 时间线的 BERT 风格模型，在一个包含7,500万名患者的去标识化 EHR 数据集上进行预训练和微调。该模型将实验室检测结果编码为离散 token，同时通过基于百分位数的分箱保留分级信息，并结合 Integrated Gradients，给出扎根于输入 EHR 序列的 token 级归因。我们在公开 EHRShot 基准套件以及一项基于真实世界数据的哮喘严重程度进展研究中测试该方法。该工作通过在单一框架内统一实验室数值表示和可解释性，填补 EHR 基础模型方法学缺口，同时考察预测性能和解释能否超越标准临床预测任务而泛化。在 EHRShot 和哮喘任务中，BERT-LER 获得了具有竞争力的预测性能，在实验室相关任务上常优于公开可用的基准模型，并提供与临床已知风险因素一致的归因。该架构和可解释性方法可应用于使用在结构化 EHR 上训练的语言模型的多种治疗领域和预测任务。
items.author_line: Jun Ni Du, Lukas Adamek, Maxim Kryukov, Flavio Dormont, Ziv Bar-Joseph, Sven Jager, Brandon Rufino

items.title: CorSeg-CineSAX: An Open-Source Deep Learning Framework for Fully Automatic Segmentation of Short-Axis Cine Cardiac MRI Across Multiple Cardiac Diseases
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Segmentation of the left ventricular (LV) myocardium, LV cavity, and right ventricular (RV) cavity on short-axis cine cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images is essential for deriving clinical functional parameters, but existing automated tools rarely combine full public availability (source code, trained weights, and a deployment tool) with validation across diverse centers, vendors, and disease categories, particularly at the technically demanding basal right/left ventricular outflow tract (RVOT/LVOT) level. Methods: We trained a two-dimensional, slice-by-slice MedNeXt-L model, without region-of-interest cropping, on a private cohort of 2,382 subjects (5 disease categories) from 12 domestic centers, and evaluated it on an independent internal test set (n = 650) and three independent external public datasets (ACDC, M and Ms1, M and Ms2; n = 855 combined), spanning 16 disease categories in total (11 never seen during training). Segmentation accuracy (Dice similarity coefficient [DSC], 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance) was assessed overall, by anatomical slice position (including the basal RVOT/LVOT level), and by disease category, center, vendor, and field strength, alongside agreement between automated and manual clinical functional parameters and benchmarking against human inter-observer variability (three independent observers, 50-subject subsample). Results: Mean DSC was 0.908 on the internal test set and 0.883 on the external test set (combined, 0.893; n = 1,505, 31,440 slices). The basal RVOT/LVOT level achieved a mean DSC of 0.904, comparable to the basal (0.910) and mid-ventricular (0.895) levels; the apex was the most challenging position (mean DSC 0.842). Performance on the 11 disease categories absent from training (mean DSC range, 0.874-0.904) was comparable to that on the five categories represented during training (0.881-0.936). Automated LV cavity and right ventricular segmentation matched or exceeded human inter-observer agreement (DSC 0.923 vs. 0.894 and 0.910 vs. 0.906, respectively), while LV myocardium remained somewhat below it (0.847 vs. 0.875). Agreement with manual functional-parameter measurements was strong for LV/RV volumes and LV mass (intraclass correlation coefficient [ICC] >= 0.961) and weaker for LV ejection fraction (ICC 0.855) and RV ejection fraction (ICC 0.900), both below the corresponding human inter-observer benchmarks (0.969 and 0.931). Conclusions: CorSeg-CineSAX provides an openly released (code, trained weights, and a standalone GUI application), transparently validated framework for fully automatic CMR short-axis segmentation, with performance at the basal outflow-tract level comparable to other anatomical positions and segmentation accuracy for the LV cavity and right ventricle approaching human inter-observer variability.
items.summary_zh: CorSeg-CineSAX 开源发布心脏短轴电影 MRI 自动分割模型，并在内部与三个独立公开外部数据集上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 1,505名受试者、16类疾病及跨中心和设备测试提供了较扎实的可复现性信息；射血分数的一致性仍低于人工观察者间基准。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：短轴电影心脏磁共振（CMR）图像中左心室（LV）心肌、LV 腔和右心室（RV）腔的分割，是获得临床功能参数所必需的；但现有自动化工具很少同时具备完全公开可用性（源代码、训练权重和部署工具）以及跨多样化中心、厂商和疾病类别的验证，尤其是在技术要求很高的基底右/左心室流出道（RVOT/LVOT）层面。方法：我们以不进行感兴趣区域裁剪的二维、逐切片 MedNeXt-L 模型，在来自12个国内中心、涵盖5类疾病的私有队列（2,382名受试者）上训练；并在独立内部测试集（n=650）和三个独立公开外部数据集（ACDC、M and Ms1、M and Ms2；合计 n=855）上评估，全部数据共覆盖16类疾病，其中11类在训练时从未出现。按总体、解剖切片位置（包括基底 RVOT/LVOT 层面）、疾病类别、中心、厂商和磁场强度评估分割准确性（Dice 相似系数[DSC]、第95百分位 Hausdorff 距离），同时评估自动与人工临床功能参数的一致性，并以人工观察者间变异作为基准（三名独立观察者，50名受试者子样本）。结果：内部测试集的平均 DSC 为0.908，外部测试集为0.883（合并为0.893；n=1,505，31,440个切片）。基底 RVOT/LVOT 层面的平均 DSC 为0.904，与基底（0.910）和中室水平（0.895）相当；心尖最具挑战性（平均 DSC 0.842）。训练中未出现的11类疾病的性能（平均 DSC 范围0.874–0.904）与训练中出现的5类疾病（0.881–0.936）相当。自动 LV 腔和右心室分割达到或超过人工观察者间一致性（DSC 分别为0.923 对0.894、0.910 对0.906），而 LV 心肌仍略低于人工一致性（0.847 对0.875）。自动功能参数与人工测量在 LV/RV 容积和 LV 质量上高度一致（组内相关系数[ICC] >=0.961），在 LV 射血分数（ICC 0.855）和 RV 射血分数（ICC 0.900）上较弱，二者均低于相应人工观察者间基准（0.969 和0.931）。结论：CorSeg-CineSAX 提供了一个已公开发布代码、训练权重和独立 GUI 应用程序，并经透明验证的全自动 CMR 短轴分割框架；其基底流出道层面性能与其他解剖位置相当，LV 腔和右心室的分割准确性接近人工观察者间变异。
items.author_line: Xu, R., Jiang, S., Zhai, Y., Xu, Y., Li, Y., Wang, J., Pu, L., Wang, K., Liang, S., Chen, Y.

items.title: Delivery of small interfering RNA and antisense oligonucleotides across the blood-brain barrier with monovalent transferrin receptor 1 binding VHH-Fc fusion proteins
items.abstract_or_text: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) is a highly selective cell layer that restricts the diffusion of diverse chemical entities into the central nervous system (CNS) from systemic circulation. Macromolecular therapeutics including oligonucleotides, peptides, and monoclonal antibodies exhibit only minimal brain distribution after systemic dosing due to exclusion by the BBB. Receptor-mediated transcytosis (RMT) has evolved to transport vital cargo across the BBB through a specialized vesicular transport pathway. Transferrin receptor 1 (TfR1) shuttles transferrin, its natural ligand, across the BBB, as well as TfR1-binding IgG antibodies and conjugates. Here, we describe a novel monovalent TfR1-binding VHH-Fc for the delivery of oligonucleotide cargo, including antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) and small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) across the BBB in rodents and non-human primates (NHPs), supporting the translational potential of the VHH-antisense RMT platform for the treatment of neurological disorders. We explore the role of binding affinity, conjugation site, drug-antibody ratio (DAR), and conjugation chemistry, and determine that binding affinity, DAR and conjugation site are major determinants of RMT capacity and brain activity of siRNAs delivered across the BBB. items.summary_zh: 单价 TfR1 结合 VHH-Fc 被用于递送 ASO 和 siRNA 穿越血脑屏障，并在啮齿动物和非人灵长类中测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究系统考察亲和力、偶联位点、DAR 和偶联化学对 CNS 活性的影响，提供了体内转运证据；距离人体治疗仍有较长验证过程。
items.abstract_zh: 血脑屏障（BBB）是高度选择性的细胞层，限制多种化学实体由体循环扩散进入中枢神经系统（CNS）。由于 BBB 的排斥，大分子治疗物，包括寡核苷酸、肽和单克隆抗体，在全身给药后的脑内分布极低。受体介导的跨胞转运（RMT）进化为通过专门的囊泡转运途径将重要载荷跨越 BBB。Transferrin receptor 1（TfR1）可将其天然配体 transferrin 转运穿过 BBB，也可转运结合 TfR1 的 IgG 抗体和偶联物。本文描述一种新型单价 TfR1 结合 VHH-Fc，用于将包括 antisense oligonucleotides（ASOs）和 small interfering RNAs（siRNAs）在内的寡核苷酸载荷递送穿越啮齿动物和非人灵长类（NHPs）的 BBB，为 VHH-反义 RMT 平台治疗神经系统疾病的转化潜力提供支持。我们探究了结合亲和力、偶联位点、药物抗体比（DAR）和偶联化学的作用，确定结合亲和力、DAR 和偶联位点是跨 BBB 递送 siRNA 的 RMT 能力和脑内活性的主要决定因素。图文摘要/要点：经工程化的 anti-TfR1（-TfR1）VHH 配体采用异二聚体、双链单价 VHH-Fc 形式，可与 siRNA 和 ASO 偶联。对一系列 TfR1 结合亲和力的 VHH 克隆进行系统体内评估，揭示 TfR1 结合亲和力与静脉给药 VHH-Fc-siRNA 偶联物的 CNS 活性之间存在关系。通过优化 TfR1 结合亲和力、偶联位点和偶联化学，我们确定了可经受体介导跨胞转运高效穿越 BBB 的 VHH-Fc-siRNA 分子；这些分子在小鼠和非人灵长类静脉（IV）或皮下（SC）给药后，可降低包括较深脑区在内的 CNS 组织中的靶 mRNA。

items.title: RTTN moonlights beyond the centrosome to control ribosome biogenesis and tRNA modification in human brain organoids
items.abstract_or_text: RTTN (rotatin) is a centrosomal protein mutated in severe malformations of cortical development, yet how its dysfunction disrupts human corticogenesis has remained unclear. Here, we show that RTTN has an unrecognized function at the core of the translation machinery. Using human telencephalic and hippocampal organoids carrying distinct RTTN alleles, together with single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, polysome profiling, and tRNA pseudouridine sequencing, we find that RTTN is enriched in cycling first-trimester neural progenitors and physically associates with ribosome-biogenesis and RNA-processing factors. RTTN mutations impair rRNA biogenesis and polysome assembly, reduce cytoplasmic ribosome density and nascent protein synthesis, and remodel the tRNA pseudouridylation landscape through both a PUS7L-dependent variable-arm signature and a broader RTTN-specific defect. These translational deficits are accompanied by prolonged mitosis, reduced entry into S-phase, and impaired interkinetic nuclear migration in mutant progenitors. Our findings redefine RTTN as a regulator of ribosome homeostasis and mRNA translation and implicate defective translational capacity as a driver of RTTN-associated microcephaly. Graphical AbstractRTTN sustains ribosome and tRNA homeostasis in human neural progenitors; its mutation disrupts mRNA translation, stalling progenitor proliferation and interkinetic nuclear migration, and driving cortical malformation and growth failure. items.summary_zh: 人脑类器官研究显示，RTTN 除中心体功能外还参与核糖体生成、tRNA 修饰和神经祖细胞翻译稳态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多等位基因类器官、单细胞与整体转录组、核糖体和 tRNA 测序共同支持 RTTN 缺陷与小头畸形相关的细胞机制，但治疗靶向价值仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: RTTN（rotatin）是一种中心体蛋白，其突变可导致严重皮层发育畸形，但其功能障碍如何扰乱人类皮层发生一直不清楚。本文显示，RTTN 在翻译机器核心具有此前未被认识到的功能。利用携带不同 RTTN 等位基因的人端脑和海马类器官，结合单细胞和整体转录组学、多聚核糖体分析以及 tRNA 假尿苷测序，我们发现 RTTN 在增殖中的妊娠第一孕期神经祖细胞中富集，并与核糖体生成和 RNA 加工因子发生物理关联。RTTN 突变损害 rRNA 生成和多聚核糖体组装，降低细胞质核糖体密度和新生蛋白合成，并通过依赖 PUS7L 的可变臂特征以及更广泛的 RTTN 特异性缺陷，重塑 tRNA 假尿苷化图谱。这些翻译缺陷伴随有丝分裂延长、进入 S 期减少以及突变祖细胞的细胞间核迁移受损。我们的发现将 RTTN 重新定义为核糖体稳态和 mRNA 翻译的调节因子，并提示翻译能力缺陷可能驱动 RTTN 相关小头畸形。图文摘要：RTTN 维持人神经祖细胞中的核糖体和 tRNA 稳态；其突变扰乱 mRNA 翻译，使祖细胞增殖和细胞间核迁移停滞，并导致皮层畸形和生长失败。
items.author_line: Hadar, A., Draganova, K., Iyer, V., Bhattacharya, B., Komemy, Y., Ponce-Arias, A., Otikovs, L., Vaknin, I., Dezorella, N., Wilk, L., Lilja, A., Doroshev, S., Olender, T., Danan-Gotthold, M., Fu, J., Merl-Pham, J., Rusha, E., Gabarro-Solanas, R., Flatley, A., Zitzelsberger, H., Feederle, R., Hauck, S., Schwartz, S., Götz, M., Reiner, O.

items.title: On the robustness of scRNA-seq foundation models for plant perturbation response prediction under cross-experiment shift
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models for single-cell transcriptomics promise to learn generalizable representations of cellular states. However, recent evidence suggests they often fail to outperform simple machine learning baselines. Furthermore, their ability to generalize across unseen experimental conditions remains poorly understood, particularly in plants, where rigorous evaluation beyond cell type annotation and batch integration is lacking. To address this, we introduce an Arabidopsis thaliana foundation model, scAraFM, and benchmark it across several perturbation conditions under three increasingly challenging protocols: random splits from a single experiment, replicate-based splits, and cross-experiment transfer learning. We found that random splits overestimate performance by up to 30 points relative to cross-experiment evaluations. Across representation strategies, preserving gene identity consistently outperforms the standard pooled embeddings. Moreover, simple baselines using raw reads remain competitive in single-experiment settings, challenging current claims of universal advantage of foundation models. In contrast, under cross-experiment transfer, pretrained representations show added value, particularly with few labelled samples, suggesting that the benefits of foundation models emerge precisely in the regimes that matter for practical deployment. Overall, our results demonstrate that conclusions about foundation models depend critically on the evaluation design, and that preserving per-gene structure aids generalization in downstream tasks, supporting robust predictions across unseen experimental contexts.
items.summary_zh: scAraFM 以拟南芥扰动响应为例，检验单细胞基础模型在跨实验分布变化下的泛化能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随机切分相较跨实验测试最多高估30个性能点，直接说明评测设计会实质改变对基础模型价值的判断。
items.abstract_zh: 用于单细胞转录组学的基础模型有望学习可泛化的细胞状态表征。然而，近期证据表明它们常常无法优于简单的机器学习基线。此外，它们对未见实验条件的泛化能力仍知之甚少，尤其在植物中，超越细胞类型注释和批次整合的严格评估尚付阙如。为此，我们引入拟南芥基础模型 scAraFM，并在若干扰动条件下，按照三种难度递增的方案对其进行基准测试：来自单一实验的随机切分、基于重复的切分和跨实验迁移学习。我们发现，相对于跨实验评估，随机切分会将性能高估最多30个点。在各种表征策略中，保留基因身份始终优于标准的池化嵌入。此外，在单一实验环境中，使用原始 reads 的简单基线仍具有竞争力，这挑战了基础模型具有普遍优势的现有主张。相反，在跨实验迁移中，预训练表征显示出附加价值，尤其是在有标签样本较少时；这表明基础模型的益处恰恰出现在实际部署所关注的情形。总体而言，我们的结果表明，对基础模型的结论关键取决于评估设计；在下游任务中保留逐基因结构有助于泛化，从而支持对未见实验环境作出稳健预测。
items.author_line: Fernandez Burda, M., Bonazzola, R., Valli, A. A., Castrillo, G., Stegmayer, G., Ferrante, E., Milone, D. H.

items.title: Automating scientific annotations for open transcriptomic profiles via multi-stage agents
items.abstract_or_text: Public transcriptomic repositories contain millions of samples, yet their large-scale reuse is hindered by heterogeneous and inconsistently reported metadata. In the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), key biological information is often distributed across study- and sample-level records, requiring context-dependent interpretation. Here we present GEOMeta, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-stage workflow with task-specialized agents for automated GEO metadata curation. The pipeline separates metadata retrieval, task-specific information extraction, field standardization, ontology mapping and quality control. Using GEOMeta, we generated standardized annotations for approximately 600,000 human bulk RNA-seq samples. To demonstrate its utility, we benchmarked transcriptome representation models for predicting sex, age, tissue and disease from transcriptome embeddings. We further prospectively annotated newly submitted GEO studies and evaluated 22 frontier LLMs. Recent open-source Flash models achieved annotation quality comparable to leading reasoning models while reducing costs by an order of magnitude. GEOMeta provides a scalable resource and reproducible framework for metadata curation.
items.summary_zh: GEOMeta 以多阶段 LLM 工作流标准化 GEO 元数据，已生成约60万个人类 bulk RNA-seq 样本注释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模公开资源与新提交研究的前瞻性测试增强了实用性；元数据自动注释仍需要持续的质量控制和领域审查。
items.abstract_zh: 公共转录组库包含数百万样本，但异质且报告不一致的元数据妨碍其大规模再利用。在 Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）中，关键生物学信息常分散于研究和样本层级记录，需要依赖语境加以解释。本文提出 GEOMeta：一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的多阶段工作流，使用任务专门化 agent 自动整理 GEO 元数据。该流程将元数据检索、任务特异的信息提取、字段标准化、本体映射和质量控制分开进行。利用 GEOMeta，我们为约60万个人类 bulk RNA-seq 样本生成标准化注释。为展示其用途，我们对转录组表征模型进行基准测试，以从转录组嵌入预测性别、年龄、组织和疾病。我们还对新提交的 GEO 研究进行前瞻性注释，并评估了22个前沿 LLM。近期的开源 Flash 模型获得了与领先推理模型相当的注释质量，同时将成本降低一个数量级。GEOMeta 提供了可扩展的资源和可复现的元数据整理框架。
items.author_line: Zhang, X., Paithankar, S., Pu, J., Murtaza, M. S., Shankar, R., Leshchiner, D., Koirala, S., Palmer, Z., Nault, R., Li, X., Xie, Y., Chen, B.

items.title: CLEAR-ST: Physics-informed probabilistic decontamination of spatial transcriptomics by modeling mRNA lateral diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics is a rapidly evolving technology that allows for the measurement of gene expression in a spatially resolved manner. However, one technical problem that occurs for many sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms is the presence of mRNA lateral diffusion, where mRNA from one spot can bind to probes in another spot, leading to contamination and inaccurate gene expression measurements. In Visium-like assays, this artifact is often visible as structured out-of-tissue signal and boundary-associated expression halos, yet its magnitude, spatial decay, and directional bias vary substantially across samples. Here, we present CLEAR-ST, a physics-informed probabilistic framework for correcting diffusion-like contamination in spatial transcriptomics data. CLEAR-ST infers a latent clean expression field using a denoising autoencoder and links it to the observed counts through a graph-Laplacian forward contamination model with learnable diffusion parameters, finally evaluated with a selectable count likelihood. We first conducted a comprehensive comparison between 10X official and independently generated Visium samples, demonstrating that out-of-tissue count profiles are highly related to nearby in-tissue expression, more concentrated near tissue boundaries, and diffusion directions across genes are likely coherent. Across real samples with varying contamination burden, CLEAR-ST improved spatial domain recovery, increased gene-level spatial autocorrelation, and enhanced the biological specificity of downstream analyses such as marker gene discovery, pathway identification and cell type deconvolution. Compared to benchmark methods, CLEAR-ST showed consistent gains in clustering quality and concordance with manual annotations. Together, CLEAR-ST provides an interpretable and practical approach for diffusion-aware correction of capture-based spatial transcriptomics data.
items.summary_zh: CLEAR-ST 以 mRNA 横向扩散为物理模型，对空间转录组捕获污染进行概率校正。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在多种真实 Visium 样本及与既有方法的比较中改善空间域和标记基因分析，为空间组学预处理提供可解释选择。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学是一项快速发展的技术，能够以空间分辨方式测量基因表达。然而，许多基于测序的空间转录组平台存在一个技术问题：mRNA 横向扩散，即一个 spot 的 mRNA 可结合到另一个 spot 中的探针，从而导致污染和不准确的基因表达测量。在类似 Visium 的检测中，这一伪影常表现为组织外具有结构的信号以及与组织边缘相关的表达晕圈，但其幅度、空间衰减和方向偏倚在样本间差异很大。本文提出 CLEAR-ST：一种受物理学启发的概率框架，用于校正空间转录组数据中类似扩散的污染。CLEAR-ST 使用去噪自编码器推断潜在的干净表达场，并通过具有可学习扩散参数的图拉普拉斯前向污染模型将其与观测计数相连，最后以可选择的计数似然进行评估。我们首先全面比较了10X 官方生成和独立生成的 Visium 样本，证明组织外计数图谱与邻近组织内表达高度相关，在组织边缘附近更集中，且基因间的扩散方向可能一致。在污染负担不同的真实样本中，CLEAR-ST 改善了空间域恢复，提高了基因水平空间自相关，并增强了标记基因发现、通路鉴定和细胞类型去卷积等下游分析的生物学特异性。与基准方法相比，CLEAR-ST 在聚类质量和与人工注释的一致性上持续提升。总体而言，CLEAR-ST 为捕获型空间转录组数据提供了一种可解释且实用的扩散感知校正方法。
items.author_line: Ma, K., Huang, Y., Ho, J. W. K.

items.title: RegFM: an interpretable context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation
items.abstract_or_text: Transcriptional regulation is governed by interactions between cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and trans-acting regulators in a context-specific manner. Although DNA and single-cell foundation models have enabled modeling regulatory biology at scale, most represent either sequence or cellular state alone, limiting their ability to capture context-dependent gene regulation. Here we present RegFM, a context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation. RegFM treats transcriptional regulation as a dialogue between cis-regulatory sequences (e.g., CREs) and trans-acting regulators (e.g., transcription factors (TFs) and chromatin regulators (CRs)) by coupling long-range CRE representations with TFs and CRs activity. Trained on large-scale ENCODE and CELLxGENE transcriptomic profiles, RegFM learns gene-centered regulatory representations that generalize across unseen cellular contexts. In a wide range of tasks, including gene expression prediction, cis-regulatory element annotation, bivalent promoter and dosage-sensitivity classification, and perturbation-response prediction, RegFM consistently improves over existing methods. RegFM emerges as a scalable and interpretable framework for modeling human transcriptional regulation and provides insights into context-dependent gene regulatory programs.
items.summary_zh: RegFM 将顺式调控序列与转录因子和染色质调控因子活性联结，学习具细胞语境的人类转录调控表征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 ENCODE 与 CELLxGENE 大规模数据上训练，并覆盖表达、元件注释和扰动响应等任务；现有摘要未提供各任务的独立量化细节。
items.abstract_zh: 转录调控由顺式调控元件（CREs）与反式作用调控因子在特异语境中的相互作用所决定。尽管 DNA 和单细胞基础模型已能大规模模拟调控生物学，多数模型仅表征序列或细胞状态之一，限制了其捕捉依赖语境的基因调控的能力。本文提出 RegFM，一种面向人类转录调控的语境感知基础模型。RegFM 将转录调控视作顺式调控序列（如 CREs）和反式作用调控因子（如转录因子[TFs]和染色质调控因子[CRs]）之间的对话：它将远程 CRE 表征与 TF 和 CR 活性相耦合。在大规模 ENCODE 和 CELLxGENE 转录组图谱上训练后，RegFM 学得以基因为中心的调控表征，可泛化到未见细胞语境。在包括基因表达预测、顺式调控元件注释、双价启动子和剂量敏感性分类以及扰动响应预测在内的广泛任务中，RegFM 均持续优于现有方法。RegFM 是一个可扩展且可解释的框架，用于模拟人类转录调控，并为依赖语境的基因调控程序提供见解。
items.author_line: Gao, Z., Sun, Y., Wang, H., Jiang, R., Liu, Q.

items.title: Long-Read epigenetic clocks identify improved brain aging predictions
items.abstract_or_text: Epigenetic clocks are widely used to estimate biological aging, yet most are built from array-based data from peripheral tissues of predominantly European-ancestry individuals, limiting their generalizability. Here, we present aging clocks on DNA methylation from Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing (LRS), leveraging over 28 million CpG sites from prefrontal cortex samples across individuals of African and European ancestry. These models were developed using GenoML, an automated machine learning platform for multi-omics data that leverages a diverse catalog of existing model architectures. Our long-read-informed clocks were developed using promoter-based and whole-genome window-based features, yielding models for each individual cohort as well as a combined-cohort clock. Each of these models demonstrated favorable performance compared to existing methylation clocks and was externally validated in a cohort of Colombian individuals. We further performed enrichment analyses and nominated both shared and cohort-specific pathways, cell types, and transcription factor binding motifs which may be implicated in aging and were not fully explained by cell type proportions or postmortem interval. Altogether, our findings highlight the power of long-read methylation data for constructing accurate, ancestry-aware aging clocks and emphasize the importance of inclusive training datasets.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 Oxford Nanopore 长读长甲基化数据构建兼顾祖源的脑衰老时钟，并在哥伦比亚队列外部验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 逾2,800万个 CpG 位点及非洲和欧洲祖源样本拓宽了脑组织表观遗传时钟的数据范围，但结论仍来自预印本模型评估。
items.abstract_zh: 表观遗传时钟被广泛用于估计生物学衰老，但多数时钟建立在以欧洲祖源个体为主的外周组织芯片数据上，限制了其泛化能力。本文提出基于 Oxford Nanopore 长读长测序（LRS）DNA 甲基化的衰老时钟，利用非洲和欧洲祖源个体前额叶皮层样本中超过2,800万个 CpG 位点。这些模型采用 GenoML 开发；GenoML 是一个用于多组学数据的自动化机器学习平台，可利用多样的既有模型架构目录。我们的长读长信息时钟采用基于启动子的特征和全基因组窗口特征开发，得到各个个体队列的模型以及一个合并队列时钟。每个模型相对于既有甲基化时钟均显示出良好性能，并在一个哥伦比亚个体队列中得到外部验证。我们还开展富集分析，并提出可能与衰老相关的共享和队列特异性通路、细胞类型及转录因子结合基序；这些结果不能完全由细胞类型比例或尸检后间隔解释。总之，我们的发现突出长读长甲基化数据构建准确、兼顾祖源的衰老时钟的能力，并强调包容性训练数据集的重要性。
items.author_line: Grant, S. M., Eger, S. J., Makarious, M. items.title: AFilter: Improved Antibody Epitope Prediction by Machine Learning-Optimized Interface Energy Filtering of AlphaFold3-Predicted Complex
items.abstract_or_text: AlphaFold3 (AF3) predicts protein-complex structures from sequence with near-experimental accuracy on many targets, substantially lowering the cost of mechanistic and therapeutic discovery. However, application to antibody epitope prediction is hampered by an approximately 63% failure rate. Comparing successful and failed AF3 predictions across antibody-antigen and nanobody-antigen complexes, we found that failed predictions share a distinctive energetic signature: distorted CDR-loop geometries and elevated van der Waals strain at the interface. Building upon these observations, we developed a machine learning-based interface energy filtering framework, designated AFilter, capable of eliminating over 90% of erroneous predictions while retaining >90% of true positives. Compared with ipTM-based filtering, AFilter improved accuracy from 82.7% to 97.7% for nanobody-antigen complexes and from 79.4% to 96.3% for antibody-antigen complexes, while simultaneously raising the true positive rate from 69.8% to 96.4% and from 63.1% to 92.5%, respectively. When applied to NeuroMab antibodies of unknown structure, AFilter prioritized high-confidence epitope predictions that AF3 sampling alone could not reliably surface. As a lightweight post-hoc filter (<5% computational overhead) that requires no re-docking, AFilter is directly compatible with existing AF3 prediction pipelines and, in principle, transferable to other diffusion-based complex predictors, providing a practical quality-assurance layer for antibody epitope mapping in early-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: AFilter 以界面能量特征筛选 AlphaFold3 生成的抗体—抗原复合物预测，提高表位预测的可信度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在摘要报告的测试中，该轻量后处理显著提高准确率并保留真阳性；其泛化到其他预测器仍是作者提出的可能性。
items.abstract_zh: AlphaFold3（AF3）可从序列预测蛋白复合物结构，并在许多靶标上达到接近实验的准确性，显著降低机制和治疗发现的成本。然而，将其应用于抗体表位预测受到约63%失败率的阻碍。通过比较抗体-抗原和纳米抗体-抗原复合物中成功和失败的 AF3 预测，我们发现失败预测具有独特的能量特征：扭曲的 CDR 环几何构象以及界面处升高的范德华应变。基于这些观察，我们开发了基于机器学习的界面能量筛选框架 AFilter，可去除超过90%的错误预测，同时保留超过90%的真阳性。相较于基于 ipTM 的筛选，AFilter 将纳米抗体-抗原复合物的准确率从82.7%提高至97.7%，将抗体-抗原复合物的准确率从79.4%提高至96.3%；同时，真阳性率分别从69.8%提高至96.4%、从63.1%提高至92.5%。应用于结构未知的 NeuroMab 抗体时，AFilter 优先筛出了仅靠 AF3 采样无法可靠发现的高置信度表位预测。作为一种计算开销低于5%、无需重新对接的轻量级后处理筛选器，AFilter 可直接兼容既有 AF3 预测流程，且原则上可迁移至其他基于扩散的复合物预测器，为早期药物发现中的抗体表位绘制提供实用的质量保证层。

review.note: 入选13项，均为 preprint；临床相关研究仅据其队列、外部测试或体内实验描述表述，不视为临床实施证据。
